svg.title: TOPAK C4 — Confinement is attested at lease grant, and the archetype rung is a confidential VM
svg.desc: ADR-0034 gives the lease's confinement: [digest, rung] field its meaning: a promoted profile of seven clauses, four rungs that say how the belief in the profile was established, an appraisal folded into the grant, and the four conjuncts of Contained(p). One test decides the archetype: delegate by failure direction. Since G9 two amendments are in force: A2, the Run profile, in which P4 is channel fidelity (Batch 30, with ADR-0042 §6), and A3, four of the reference's choices (Batch 29); the declared rung is per seat (ADR-0023 A1). The reference grants rung 0, launches rung 1 under its own assertion and rung 3 only SIMULATED (ADR-0033 A7, ratified Batch 29 ahead of ADR-0036, which is Proposed). No guest passes P3, so no real principal is Contained (G10 §2.3, item 1); an operator and an emergency seat are Mediated by design. The module's four invariants are proved for every rung at once (B25), and finding 6's successor Confinement_A1 is checked and proved; neither proof certifies (G10 §2.9), and neither adds confinement to the reference.
svg.text: TOPAK · C4

text.tspan: Confinement is attested at lease grant, and the archetype rung is a confidential VM

svg.text: ADR-0034 gives the lease's confinement: [digest, rung] field its meaning: a promoted profile of seven clauses, four rungs that say how the belief in the profile was established, an appraisal folded into the grant, and the four conjuncts of Contained(p). One test decides the archetype: delegate by failure direction. Since G9 two amendments are in force: A2, the Run profile, in which P4 is channel fidelity (Batch 30, with

ADR-0042 §6), and A3, four of the reference's choices (Batch 29); the declared rung is per seat (ADR-0023 A1). The reference grants rung 0, launches rung 1 under its own assertion and rung 3 only SIMULATED (ADR-0033 A7, ratified Batch 29 ahead of ADR-0036, which is Proposed). No guest passes P3, so no real principal is Contained (G10 §2.3, item 1); an operator and an emergency seat are Mediated by design. The

module's four invariants are proved for every rung at once (B25), and finding 6's successor Confinement_A1 is checked and proved; neither proof certifies (G10 §2.9), and neither adds confinement to the reference.

text.tspan: Accepted · C2, C4 · ratified 2026.09.28, Batch 10 · A2 (B30), A3 (B29) applied

svg.text: Discharges ADR-0022 §6 for Build, and with A2 the Run profile. ADR-0035 (the fourth conjunct) and ADR-0036 (the rung-1 launcher; the rung-0 declared profile, R1) are
The substrate may carry a mechanism whose failure only subtracts authority. A mechanism whose failure
could add or preserve authority is authored by TOPAK and consensus-backed.
Rung 1: a faulty or hostile launcher produces a valid-looking lease for a guest it did not confine: a failure that
adds authority.
Rung 2: the hypervisor can alter a running guest after its launch measurement: the same failure one layer
down.
Rung 3: every residual host power is subtractive (§5), met by construction rather than by trusting the host.
Hence the archetype.
With consensus for grants, local for denials, the core is PC/EC: an unreachable verifier stops grants; live
leases run to renewal; every refusal, expiry and revocation takes the path that needs no quorum.
by the operator, verified by nobody
Evidence: none. Mediated, always (ADR-0031 §3). A rung-0 grant may name
a profile: its verdict is then derived from declared clauses (ADR-0036 R1).
The reference: a seat declared at rung 0 (ADR-0023 §6c).
by the launcher
Evidence: the launcher's assertion; appraised by nobody. Adds the host
operator and orchestrator. Contested unreachable. The launcher binds the
session (ADR-0036). The reference: the node's launcher (A7, ratified B29).
launch measurement
Evidence: a measured-boot TPM quote. Adds host firmware and the
hypervisor. Detects a rogue launch; not an altered running guest.
hardware, independent verifier
Evidence: a confidential-VM hardware report. Adds the CPU vendor's root of
trust, the verifier, the promoted image. Every residual host power subtracts.
The reference: SIMULATED, test keys.

text.tspan: The rung ladder: how the belief in the profile was established

svg.text: Words per rung from ADR-0036 R1 (Proposed); rungs, evidence and trusted base from ADR-0034 §2, §6; degeneracy ids from §8
the profile is the constant, the rung the variable: elevation is a fresh grant naming the same digest (ADR-0036 R1, Proposed; ADR-0031 A1). Each step changes one thing: a clause verdict or the rung

text.tspan: §2: the rungs, defined (the full table; numbers ascend with strength)
Trusted for integrity of the guest

svg.text: Confidential-VM hardware report (the SEV-SNP or TDX class), with the launch measurement covering
firmware, kernel, initrd, root hash, profile digest and Persona digest
An independent verifier: not the host operator, not the mechanism (RFC
9334 roles)
The CPU vendor's root of trust and firmware, the verifier, and the promoted image
Only subtract (§5)
None: the archetype
Measured-boot TPM quote over the same values
The mechanism, against the profile's reference values
Also the host firmware and hypervisor
Launch a rogue image (detected: Contested). The hypervisor is trusted not to alter a running
guest
The launcher's assertion of the profile it launched
Nobody. The orchestrator is the attester by construction
Also the host operator and orchestrator
Nothing, by assumption. The assumption is the trusted-base entry
None
Mediated, always (ADR-0031 §3)

The verifier is a trust root: replacing it adds authority, so its appraisal key is in the issued rules (ADR-0025 A1, item (f)) and replacing it is an issuance. Rung 1 cannot produce Contested: with no measurement there is nothing to diverge (NeverContested holds at rung 1, and at rung 0).

text.tspan: §1: the confinement profile is a promoted Build artifact, and fixes seven clauses

svg.text: One channel. The guest's only I/O device is a single host–guest channel, such as vsock, to the mechanism's front door (ADR-0033 §2). There is no network device
Egress. The protocol and the channel become the same thing
Filesystem. A measured read-only root, the round's workspace read-write, and the pinned corpus root read-only and content-addressed. Nothing else is mounted
Reads and writes outside workspace and corpus

No launcher for the principal. The only code the principal can cause to run is its own inference and Invoke of an allowlisted tool. The image has no shell, package manager or interpreter reachable from the principal
Effects that no action names
Tools are Wasm components, instantiated per call and handed only a workspace directory capability. No sockets, no wall clock, and no entropy source not derived from the inputs
ADR-0022 §3's hermeticity obligation, discharged by construction rather than by review (finding 2)

Inference is inside. The Persona's weights are in the guest, and their digest is part of the launch measurement (ADR-0016 §6). An accelerator, if used, runs in confidential-compute mode, and its attestation is part of the evidence
Prompt egress (ADR-0017) and device-memory paths
One principal per guest, one guest per round. A guest is launched for the grant and destroyed when the round ends. Nothing survives except through Submit and Emit
Cross-round and cross-principal state (ADR-0008 placement)
The profile carries its reference values. These are the launch measurement it expects and the minimum platform TCB version it accepts. Changing either is a new profile, and so a promotion
Reference values that move without review

A digest nobody promoted is not a reference value, so it cannot be attested. Build and Run share the schema, not the profile: Build's is fully determined by ADR-0022's alphabet; Run's is ADR-0034 A2, below.

text.tspan: §1, A2: the Run profile, in force since Batch 30 with ADR-0042 §6: the same schema with
, and P4 replaced by channel fidelity
Accepted · C2, C4 · A2 at R4, Batch 30

svg.text: One channel, to the front door; no network device. Unchanged
Egress from the guest. A Run principal's only route to an effect is an Actuate admitted at the front door

A measured read-only root and nothing else mounted. Run has no workspace (it has no Draft) and the Run root is not mounted: an admitted Consult delivers its object over the channel, node-side, as ADR-0036 §3 does Read (drafter's choice)
Reads outside the Run root, and a second, unrecorded ingress path
No launcher for the principal. The only code the principal can cause to run is its own inference and Actuate of an allowlisted tool
Effects that no action names

Channel fidelity. Every Run tool is a Wasm component, instantiated per call by the tool host, handed a working-directory capability for the round and one network capability: a connection to the target its allowlist entry declares, and no other socket. The tool host reads that target from the entry of the

bundle revision the lease names, and from nowhere else (R4; ADR-0049 §5). It may read a clock and draw entropy: a Run tool is not hermetic. The capability binds the target; the declared kind (the protocol) is recorded with the call and is not enforced
An effect on a channel nobody declared. Fidelity holds by construction, a check and not a trust, as P4 makes hermeticity one in Build
Inference is inside. Unchanged
Prompt egress and device-memory paths
One principal per guest, one guest per round, and the guest is destroyed when the round ends, which in Run is when the lease ends (ADR-0042 §5). Nothing survives except through Actuate and Report
Cross-round and cross-principal state
Unchanged. The tool host is not in the guest's measurement: its identity is fixed by the release (ADR-0045 T-0045-25)
Reference values that move without review

text.tspan: Who checks it: the tool host's Wasm runtime

svg.text: Channel fidelity is about which channel, not what is said on it: an Actuate that drives the declared valve the wrong way is an admitted effect with a
record, for the floor, the bundle and the Observer.
ADR-0045 T-0045-24 moves from excluded to delegated to T-0045-25 for a Wasm tool at the archetype; excluded for a native one (D-0034-5, D-0034-6).
A Run seat without Actuate meets P4 vacuously.

text.tspan: Met at ratification (B30), and at the reference since

svg.text: spec/RunConfinement.tla: Safe holds with and without the filter; M_CHANNEL, M_NATIVE and M_FILTER break what they must (13 rows, below); both
invariants proved and certified (116 obligations).
The reference: a Run tool hosted as a Wasm module reaches its declared target and nothing else; a lease whose Run profile claims P4 is held to such tools
at decide and at apply (A8). Since A9 the target is read from the entry of the lease's revision; node configuration states no channel (G10 item 84).

text.tspan: What the reference still does not do (A8, A9; G10 item 89)

svg.text: A Run tool is a Wasm core module, not a component (PROVISIONAL tool-abi, mechanism/ I44).
The protocol on the target is not enforced; a native tool's target stays an assertion (G19).
Build's P4 is not held to Wasm tools for Invoke. Annex B keeps T-0045-24 excluded at the reference, for a reason A9 ended (item 89).
No Run principal is Contained: the criterion is set nowhere; Run's contained = true is reached only in a SIMULATED rung-3 run.

text.tspan: No silent downgrade, at grant and at renewal (§3.4, §3.6; ADR-0031 A1)

svg.text: A principal whose evidence does not reach the declared rung is refused, not granted as Mediated: downgrading would turn a declared vacuity back into a silent one.

Renewal re-attests with a fresh nonce and keeps the rung: Attested renews at the same rung, Unattestable lets the lease lapse, Contested is a targeted revocation. It re-measures the launch, not the running guest, so it never turns
Contested (finding 5). An epoch fence invalidates every pending appraisal.
The session is the attested guest's (§3.5): at rungs 2 and 3 the attested session key replaces the reference's bearer token; at rung 1 the launcher binds the session and is trusted to.

text.tspan: : no members at any rung today

svg.text: Before ADR-0034 the reason was that no rung had semantics; now the
criterion is the only missing premise (finding 1). The custodian kept
ADR-0031's stricter reading: the draft had left independence out (R2).
The reference computes the four as a lookup and names each that fails; it
answers yes only for a SIMULATED rung-3 lease under a criterion a test
issued, Build or Run: a witness, not a claim (G10 §2.3).
An operator and an emergency seat are Mediated by design: a person is
not confined (ADR-0050 §1; ADR-0052 §1, both provisional).
B6, principal type Contained / Mediated: safety theorems quantify inside only; fixed at lease grant. Rung 0 is Mediated, always.

B12, deployment stack (sandbox and below): the register's empty cell, "no mechanism exists". ADR-0031 §3 gave it its instant, the grant; ADR-0034 gives the rungs; the mechanism half is narrowed, not closed: a rung-1 launcher and a
simulated rung 3 (mechanism/ G1; A7, ratified B29). ToO A1 is not met.

This trades an assumption for a mechanism: A1 conditioned on nothing becomes a claim resting on named, audited components with a published attack history, which is still strictly more. The hardware is in the "operationally audited" layer,
not proved. T-0045-21 (inference attestation) is reserved.

Rungs 1 and 2 void no theorem; they move what the theorems rest on (ADR-0023 §4a). ADR-0036 adds D-0036-1 (an interpreter reachable from the principal: P3 falsified), the same kind of entry as D-0034-3; ADR-0036 is Proposed. D-0034-5 and D-0034-6 are A2's, in force since Batch 30.

The M_HOST rows are the rung ladder, checked: the same mutation breaks containment at rungs 1 and 2 and changes nothing at rung 3; M_HW shows rung 3 rests on the hardware assumption. Under M_STALE, M_DOWNGRADE and M_RENEWLOW, ContainedMeansConfined still holds: those clauses are about honest declaration, not containment. Finding 6: under M_HOST at rung 0 the module reaches Contested (it reads a launch measurement rung 0 does not have). This table carries only the
rung-0 rows the defect does not affect; the successor module carries the correction (the last group).

text.tspan: Since 2026.10.02: the four invariants are proved, every rung at once (ADR-0034 B25); proved, and not certified

svg.text: spec/Confinement_proof.tla (2f4b4bb96d1f83f3) extends the frozen module and proves its four invariants for every declared rung in 0..3 at once, assuming Declared ∈ 0..3: 502 obligations, every one proved by the prover T-0045-31 (ADR-0046 §4). That is §7's ratification condition, Safe at every rung, stated as a theorem (ADR-0034 B25).

Each theorem takes as hypothesis only the mutations that break it: ContainedMeansConfined not under M_HOST, M_HW, M_CONTESTED, M_UNBOUND, M_PROFILE; NoSilentDowngrade not under M_DOWNGRADE, M_RENEWLOW; ContestedStopped not under M_CONTESTED; FreshAppraisal not under M_STALE. The rows above stay with TLC: that a mutation reaches a bad state is existential (ADR-0046 §2).

Correction 4 (ADR-0046 §5): a lease is bound to its guest by Act's generation check, which M_UNBOUND removes, not by SameGuest at grant, which the proof never uses. The proof needed an invariant of six clauses binding a lease to the guest generation it was granted against (G8 §3, result 1).
The successor's proof, Confinement_A1_proof.tla: 503 obligations, the same proof with one case split moved, so that rung 0 joins rung 1 under the low-rung invariant.

Neither proof certifies (ADR-0046 A1; G10 §2.9, item 74): of each, 3 obligations, large type-invariant steps, are proved by Z3 and by nothing else, since cvc5 does not prove them; 337 or 338 are closed by normalization, 157 by SMT with a proof the checker accepted, 5 temporal steps by LS4. Restructuring is deferred by the custodian. RunConfinement_proof.tla is certified: 116 obligations, 71 trivial, 42 checked SMT, 3 LS4.

A proof of the module adds nothing at the reference: for a real deployment ContainedMeansConfined and ContestedStopped stay void; NoSilentDowngrade and FreshAppraisal hold at the reference's apply-time checks, on every traced state (binding table; trace validation at 82 traces, ADR-0033 A14). Contained has no members in any real run (G10 §2.3, §8).
